subject: Mutual action plan: evidence owners, retention options & DPA lane
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kate Miller <kate.miller@larkpay.com>, security@larkpay.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan: evidence owners, retention options & DPA lane

Kate / LarkPay security team —

Thanks again for the call yesterday. To keep momentum toward a June close we sketched a compact mutual action plan (MAP) and assigned temporary owners so nothing falls into the gaps. Please review and call out any timing mismatches.

High-level milestones (proposed)
- Evidence intake window: 2028-06-10 -> 2028-06-15
- Legal redlines complete (DPA): 2028-06-18
- Final sign (mutual): target 2028-06-25

Ownership matrix (temporary assignments)
- SOC 2 report + attestation: Kimberly Park (Redwood) — deliver by 2028-06-12
- CAIQ / SIG summary: Jonas Weber (Redwood) — deliver by 2028-06-12
- DPA redline coordination: LarkPay legal + Redwood legal (primary: Neha Kapoor) — DPA draft to be shared 2028-06-05
- Data retention & residency confirmation: Kimberly Park & Aisha Rahman — confirm options by 2028-06-07

Retention options we can confirm up front (we'll include these in the DPA appendix):
- Short window: 30 days (best for ephemeral test data)
- Standard: 90 days (default for hosted API logs)
- Extended: 365 days (for audit/archive needs)
Note: EU residency or Private deployment options change the residency guarantees; will flag per your target region.

I've attached a quick CSV (proposed-map-owners.csv) with the same owner list so you can edit directly.

Next asks:
1) Confirm that the proposed milestones match LarkPay's internal close plan (your call suggested late June).
2) Which retention window do you expect will be required for the eval data?
3) Please add your counsel on the DPA redline thread so we can track changes.

I'll loop in Neha on the DPA lane and Kimberly/Jonas will drop the SOC2 + CAIQ deliverables early next week.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
attachments: proposed-map-owners.csv (stub)

From: Kate Miller <kate.miller@larkpay.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@larkpay.com
Date: Mon, 04 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: evidence owners, retention options & DPA lane

Thanks Aisha — this is helpful. A few clarifying items from our side: 

1) Timeline: LarkPay's aim is to have legal sign-off and procurement complete by ~2028-06-28. If Redwood can deliver the SOC2 and SIG artifacts ~2028-06-12 that should give our GC team enough runway to redline the DPA.

2) SOC2 / SIG: can you confirm whether the SOC2 report you will share is the full attestation (PDF) or a redacted summary? Also, does Redwood maintain completed CAIQ/ SIG answers or would you provide a distilled evidence pack?

3) Data retention: our security team is leaning toward a 90-day window for evaluation logs; longer retention will require additional review. Are the 30/90/365 windows you suggested configurable per customer route or is that global per account? Also — we are evaluating an EU-only residency variant; what's the shortest lead time to provision a Private/EU environment?

4) DPA: Can you send the DPA draft to kate.counsel@larkpay.com so our outside counsel can start redlining? If Redwood prefers, send a link to a DocuSign/Drive copy.

If you can confirm the SOC2 PDF and CAIQ approach I will push to align our legal / procurement dates.

Onward,
Kate Miller
Head of Procurement, LarkPay

Hey all — quick answers to Kate's questions and a proposal for how we'll deliver evidence.

SOC2: we will provide the full 2027 SOC 2 Type II attestation PDF (attestor letter + control narrative). In cases where customers need redacted versions we can produce a redacted PDF, but our standard is the full attestation. Attached: SOC2-summary-2027.txt (high level index + which artifacts we can share).

CAIQ / SIG: Redwood maintains a completed CAIQ and SIG-lite set internally. For evals we typically provide a distilled evidence pack (key answers + link to the full CAIQ under NDA). If your counsel requires complete SIG responses we can provision them through a secure share once the NDA/DPA is in place.

Retention and residency:
- The retention windows (30/90/365) are configurable per account and per route. You can request a retention profile tied to the route you will use for the eval.
- EU-only Private placement: lead time depends on capacity but we can typically provision a Private/EU trial environment in ~10 business days if required (faster with Dedicated commitment).

Evidence ownership (I propose final owners and deliverables):
- SOC2 PDF: Kimberly Park — deliver by 2028-06-12
- CAIQ distilled pack + link: Jonas Weber — deliver by 2028-06-12
- DPA draft review + legal touchpoint: Neha Kapoor (Redwood Legal) — will accept comments at kate.counsel@larkpay.com; we will post editable DPA on Drive by 2028-06-05

I'll drop the SOC2-summary-2027.txt into the Drive link Aisha provided and share access to LarkPay counsel (unless you prefer DocuSign).

Kimberly Park
Head of Trust & Security Operations, Redwood Inference
